comparison.objective: Stand one slat on a mark and slide two crossing slats down so their slots interlock.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support of an unstable member and repeated slot alignment/insertion; no hammer impact or deliberate breakage.
comparison.success_condition: Both crossings interlocked within 6 mm positional and 4 mm height tolerances, all slats upright, base aligned within 2 cm/5 degrees, and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization and alignment do not erase the different tested outcome: constructing two half-lap joints versus fracturing and recovering four tangs without disturbing inserts.
